codes.means: the document has no YAML header, so it names no standard and says nobody it is for
codes.fix: write the header by hand (standard, title, kind, audience, created, status); document-md stamp cannot fix this, because it never gives a headerless file a header

codes.means: the document names no standard, the bare unversioned document URL written before versions, or another kind's standard
codes.fix: document-md stamp <home> --apply adds or upgrades it; a record naming another kind's standard is not a document, so move or fix it by hand

codes.means: the document names a version of the document standard this validator does not implement
codes.fix: install the document-md version that implements it, or rewrite the record to https://hypercontext.wiki/standards/document/v1

codes.means: audience is missing or empty: the document does not say who it is for
codes.fix: set audience: freeda (the next session), self, a people slug, or a role in plain words ("an investor")

codes.means: the file name is neither YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-slug.md nor the legacy YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md
codes.fix: rename it to YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-slug.md, the moment it was written

codes.means: kind is not one of the document genres
codes.fix: set kind to brief, spec, design, plan, decision, draft, analysis, transcript or other

codes.means: status is not one of the document states
codes.fix: set status to draft, active, approved, final, shipped or superseded

codes.means: narrator is not one of the read-aloud engines
codes.fix: set narrator to kokoro or elevenlabs, or remove it

codes.means: theme is not light, dark or system
codes.fix: set theme to light, dark or system, or remove it

codes.means: comments is not off, anyone or signed-in
codes.fix: set comments to off, anyone or signed-in, or remove it

codes.means: comments_visible is not owner or readers
codes.fix: set comments_visible to owner or readers, or remove it

codes.means: created is not a real date written YYYY-MM-DD
codes.fix: set created to the date the document was written, YYYY-MM-DD

codes.means: a name in people is not a person slug (lowercase, kebab-case)
codes.fix: write each person as their slug, e.g. dana-reyes

codes.means: state is not a map of key: value pairs
codes.fix: write state as a map, e.g. state: {visibility: private}, or remove it

codes.means: a key other than state holds a nested map; the header is flat
codes.fix: flatten it into keys of their own, or move it into the body

codes.means: a list holds something other than strings
codes.fix: make every list item a plain string

codes.means: a list key (people, definitions, define) holds one value, or a one-value key holds a list
codes.fix: write people, definitions and define as lists, and every other known key as one value

codes.means: a one-value key holds more than one line or more than 400 characters
codes.fix: keep it to one line of at most 400 characters; a paragraph belongs in the body under a heading
